portal.title: Application Portal
portal.inactive: Not active. Apply an alias to let users open this app directly after DSM sign-in.
portal.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to set this up
portal.entryOff: This app has no Application Portal entry yet. Enable the entry so that an alias can open it after DSM sign-in.
portal.cleanupRequired: The Application Portal entry was not fully removed. Remove the entry again.
portal.portal_alias_invalid: Use 1-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
portal.portal_alias_reserved: DSM already uses this alias. Choose another one.
portal.portal_alias_in_use: Another app already uses this alias. Choose another one.
portal.admin_required: Only a DSM administrator can change this.
portal.portal_unavailable: DSM did not accept the change. Try again or use Control Panel.
portal.PORTAL_FAILED: DSM did not accept the Application Portal change. Try again.
portal.removeFromPage: This page will stop working. To enable the entry again, open this app from the DSM desktop and go to Settings > Application Portal. Remove the entry?
portal.removedFromPage: Entry removed. This page no longer works. Open this app from the DSM desktop, then go to Settings > Application Portal > Enable entry.
portal.removalUnconfirmed: This page may no longer work. Open this app from the DSM desktop and check Settings > Application Portal.
